about: License texts for the desktop package's runtime packages that ship no license file of their own (desktop-app ticket 23; the user's decision in ticket 22: version-qualified official texts, as uiw-react-codemirror-4.25.11-LICENSE in Stage 11). Each entry is tied to one exact package version: when the dependency directory has another version, the desktop package's license check fails until the text is checked again. kind: upstream-file = the repository's license file at the commit or tag the version was released from; upstream-readme = the License section of the README at that commit (lines given), the only text upstream has; no-upstream-text = the repository has no license text at that commit and its README only says the license's name, so the SPDX text of the declared license is shipped with that statement (the copyright holder is the package.json author).
